# Alireza Toghiani (DevMvRick)

> Alireza Toghiani is a senior iOS engineer in Montreal, Canada. He builds and ships his own SwiftUI apps and shares app building and endurance sport (running, marathon, HYROX) online as DevMvRick.

- Works on iOS at Everyday Health Group (Ziff Davis). Before that he led the iOS team at EBCOM, an 8M-user app.
- Silver medal in Mobile App Development at WorldSkills Asia 2021.
- Endurance athlete and runner. Ran his first marathon in Toronto in May 2026. Next challenge: a first HYROX race in Vancouver on December 19, 2026.

## Apps

- [MonFrigo](https://alireza12t.github.io/MonFrigo/): fridge tracker for iPhone that warns you before food expires, in English and French
- [Ganjineh](https://ganjinehparsi.com): Persian poetry for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch

## Open source

- [Foldline](https://github.com/alireza12t/foldline): MCP server that renders HTML canvas animations to MP4 on a Mac
- [Thinstream](https://github.com/alireza12t/thinstream): listen mode for YouTube as a browser extension
